# N+T Creative Studio

> N+T is a multi-disciplinary creative studio founded by Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter in India, working across branding, design, identity, and creative communication through multiple mediums for brands and individuals in architecture, art, fashion, beauty, hospitality, and their cultural intersections.

N+T is an extension of Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter’s creative practice. With 6+ years of building brands, the studio operates at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and intentional design.

## Core Identity & Philosophy
- **Studio Name**: N+T (N+T Creative Studio / nplust.in)
- **Founders**: Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter
- **Experience**: 6+ years of building brands across cultural disciplines
- **Location**: India (Serving clients globally)
- **Contact Email**: hello@nplust.in
- **Instagram**: @nplust.in (https://instagram.com/nplust.in)
- **Methodology**: Led by intuition, N+T understands design as a part of life, with stories and dialogue at the core of everything. Each project starts with a deconstruction of the known, analysing cultural relevance, attending to feelings first, and then shifting focus to form, informed by the multiple layers of meaning it holds.

## Services & Capabilities
- Brand Strategy & Positioning
- Visual Identity Systems & Brand Architecture
- Websites & Digital Experiences
- Packaging Design & Tactile Print Mediums
- Creative Direction & Moving Image Production
- Creative Communication Across Multiple Mediums

## Cultural Sectors & Industries
- Architecture & Spatial Design
- Contemporary Art & Cultural Institutions
- Fashion & Apparel
- Beauty & Wellness
- Hospitality & Culinary Experiences

## Featured Work
- **Transit Production**: Visual identity, emblem design, and creative direction exploring coastal narratives, cinema, and lived stories in South India.
